user.title: WLED Audio-Reactive Receiver
user.description: Receive WLED audio sync packets and drive lights and Hyperion with them.

data_description.port: Port the sender sends to. WLED's default is 11988.
data_description.multicast: Receive WLED's default multicast packets. Turn off if the sender sends unicast to this host only.
data_description.sender: Accept packets only from this IPv4 address. Leave empty to accept any sender.
data_description.media_player: Drive the outputs only while this media player is playing. Leave empty to react whenever packets arrive.
data_description.light_mode: How the lights share the audio.
data_description.update_rate: Light commands per second. Each command uses a transition as long as the interval.
data_description.restore: Snapshot the lights when music starts and restore them when it ends. Leave off if automations set the lights after playback.
data_description.hyperion: Send the frequency bands to a Hyperion.NG server as an image.
data_description.hyperion_host: Host name or IP address of the Hyperion.NG server.
data_description.hyperion_port: Hyperion's JSON server port, 19444 by default.
data_description.hyperion_priority: Lower numbers win. 150 is above screen capture (230-250) and below Home Assistant's Hyperion integration (128).
data_description.hyperion_layout: Where the frequency bands appear around the screen.

error.port_in_use: Another receiver already uses this port.
error.invalid_sender: Enter an IPv4 address, or leave the field empty.
error.min_above_max: Minimum brightness must not be above maximum brightness.
error.hyperion_host_required: Enter the Hyperion host, or turn off Hyperion.

options.mix: Mix: every light follows the whole mix (brightness from volume, colour from the bass, mid and treble balance)
options.split: Split: the frequency bands are divided among the lights in the order selected, lowest first

options.bottom_up: Bottom to top: bass at the bottom centre, rising up both sides to treble at the top centre (mirrored left and right)
options.four_way: Sides to top and bottom: bass at the middle of each side, rising to treble at the top and bottom centres (mirrored four ways)
